description: Compile bounded task-specific context from authorized memory, ContextPage items, graph and recency signals, semantic retrieval, and reusable procedures. Writes a ContextPage and a retrieval receipt for fresh retrieval. An existing receipt can supply a currently authorized typed path and two compact endpoint previews for its original task; exact endpoint projections require owning hydration. Returns selected context with its retrieval policy; context withheld by policy is not released. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

includeTypedPathEndpoints.description: Request both compact endpoint previews of one currently authorized, grounded typed path. Requires its existing receipt and original task; does not authorize arbitrary joined claims or actions.

retrievalReceiptRef.description: Existing authorized receipt UUID or business reference. Receipt bodies and authority overrides are not accepted.

task.description: Original user task text, unchanged, including explicit constraints.

name: context_compile
title: Compile task context
